title: Enforce exact GitHub issue-comment response status parity and runtime schema coverage

phases.objective: Complete the bounded follow-up to PR #6645 by removing the stale 200 success contract from the existing github_create_issue_comment runtime row, preserving canonical 201 Created, synchronizing active exports, and making non-exported runtime-callable endpoints visible in schema coverage without weakening the existing unknown-outcome mutation guard.

e2e_journeys.actor: Platform operator certifying a registry-driven GitHub create-comment endpoint before governed migration rollout
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: canonical github_rest.yaml createIssueComment -> migration source -> endpoints.schema_json -> optional platform_endpoint_tool_exports -> runtime_endpoint_call
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact active/ready GitHub create-comment endpoint advertises 201 Created and no stale 200 success response, any active export is byte-aligned with the endpoint row, non-exported runtime-callable endpoints remain visible in runtime schema coverage, and post-side-effect schema drift remains non-retryable and reconciliation-required.
steps: Verify the repository canonical GitHub createIssueComment operation declares 201 Created with the Comment schema.
Require exactly one active/ready http_generic_api github_create_issue_comment endpoint row before registry mutation.
Remove only responses.200 from that exact endpoint schema and reassert responses.201 as a tolerant JSON object response contract.
Synchronize active endpoint exports sourced from the same endpoint row after exact response repair.
Expose a dedicated exact-response parity view that blocks when 200 remains or 201 is absent.
Expose runtime endpoint schema coverage beginning from active/ready http_generic_api endpoints rather than export rows so non-exported callable endpoints cannot disappear from inventory.
Retain UNKNOWN_OUTCOME_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED with retry_allowed=false for successful mutating provider responses that later fail local schema validation.
assertions: The historical 20260808 migration is not edited, preserving its merged checksum and rollout provenance.
No new endpoint row is inserted and no method, path, authorization material, provider URL, or credential is supplied by callers.
Exact response repair removes the legacy 200 key and preserves 201 Created for the existing canonical endpoint only.
Active exports are synchronized from endpoints.schema_json but export presence is not treated as runtime-callability authority.
v_github_issue_comment_exact_response_parity is ready only when the endpoint has 201, has no 200, and every active export sourced from it is exact and contains no 200.
v_runtime_endpoint_schema_coverage starts from endpoints and explicitly classifies covered_runtime_not_exported instead of dropping those rows.
The coverage view is diagnostic and does not falsely claim provider-canonical equality without higher-level certification evidence.
The existing post-mutation unknown-outcome guard remains unchanged and no automatic retry is introduced.
The source change performs no provider call, credential read, external send/write, runtime dispatch, database apply, Production mutation, force push, PREPARE, or EXECUTE.
